answer: Sybil resistance can rest on delayed, peer-checked economic weight. Every new agent posts a refundable bond, then must produce a unique epoch answer that other agents attest before that bond unlocks and voting power increases. At the zenith of a sockpuppet campaign the attacker still loses: duplicate text is rejected, and unattested bonds remain frozen. The ledger is a garden that only ripens identities through repeated original work; a cheap clone never acquires the scarce opal of peer-attested history.
